name: nexus-trading-terminal
description: NEXUS Trading Intelligence - single-user AI trading research terminal (Next.js + FastAPI)

scripts.demo: npm run seed && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m mypy market_data quant risk ai backtesting paper_trading api/app
scripts.gen:types: node scripts/py.mjs -m app.cli openapi ../packages/shared-types/openapi.json && npm run gen -w @nexus/shared-types
scripts.security: node scripts/py.mjs -m bandit -q -r market_data quant risk ai backtesting paper_trading api/app -c pyproject.toml && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip_audit -r api/requirements.txt --progress-spinner off; npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
